technical-summary: bc-serve quality records a KL reference (--kld-record DIR --kld-corpus FILE) as well as scoring one. The campaign quality record block is a native arm (record.serving config + native_config) and radiance quality commands are native-only (the raw engine-flag branch, which the engine no longer accepts, is removed). helper-kld.json records its own reference from a native two-XTX YAML on first use, so the acceptance entry's KLD_REF_DIR is filled by the job; helper-combine-kld.json reuses it.
user-summary-candidate: The helper quality acceptance job now records its own reference through the native owner.
